description: Mark team roles as a person's own, the way they do it on the board's sheet: a role without 'needsApproval' is held at once; a role with it becomes a request the board's administrators confirm or decline (they are told) and counts nowhere until then — even when you, marking for somebody, are an administrator: giving outright is give_team_role. 'roles' are names as 'a,b'. With 'replace': true the list is the person's WHOLE set — roles left out are taken off and requests taken back; without it the roles are added to what they have. 'who' is 'me' by default; marking for somebody else is for the board's owner and its administrators. Answers with each role's state: held or requested.

replace.description: true: the list is the person's whole set of self-marked roles.

who.description: The person: their username or e-mail, 'me', or by Telegram — 'tg:<numeric id>' or '@handle' as their account carries it from a Telegram sign-in. Somebody named by Telegram who is not on the board is not found. Default 'me'.

name: claim_team_roles
title: Claim team roles
